title: B-Roll: Release of Hawaiian Monk Seal R7AF
credit: NOAA Fisheries, taken under NMFS MMHSRP Permit #18786
slate: All footage courtesy of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, a federal agency of the U.S. Department of Commerce. On January 27, 2022, a NOAA-led team responded to hooked juvenile male Hawaiian monk seal R7AF at Hanauma Bay, O'ahu. The seal was then treated at Ke Kai Ola on Hawai'i Island for fishing gear ingestion. Video: R7AF exiting a seal carrier after NOAA and Hawaii Marine Animal Response released him on O'ahu on February 2, 2022.
